I'm tracing the diagonal from (9,7) heading up-left, checking each cell to confirm they're empty as I simulate the move step by step.

When the path reaches the edge at column 1, I bounce off by flipping the column direction to move right instead, continuing up-right. Then near row 0, I bounce off the top edge too, flipping to move downward. Following the new down-right direction, I hit an occupied cell with 7 at (4,6), so the piece stops just before it at (3,5), giving the final board with a 4 placed there.
